frozen_chain.current_state: ELITE displayed immigration-nexus locations or leads and supplied geographic intelligence; exact source data and Palantir production configuration are missing.

Officers described ELITE probabilities and acknowledged that even a 100-percent result could be wrong; the Woodburn apartment complex was selected using field-office intelligence and ELITE-supported density logic.
Officers ran plate checks and later used Mobile Fortify; ELITE is not shown to have individually identified M-J-M-A-.
ICE Team 7 surveilled, followed and stopped the van; officers made the arrest decision using additional observations and databases.
M-J-M-A- was stopped, arrested, detained, transported out of state, presented removal documents and released the next day without explanation.
No pre-action notice or opportunity to contest the geographic or individual intelligence is demonstrated; litigation later obtained testimony, body-camera evidence and records.
A habeas petition and TRO motion preceded unexplained release; later preliminary and classwide injunctive relief shifted the legal burden prospectively.
The court record documents fear and practical injury; no ELITE record correction, deletion, model change, vendor remedy or compensation is established.

causal_fault_lines: ELITE geographic prioritization does not prove ELITE individual identification.
A Palantir-developed application does not make Palantir the field arresting authority.
ICE use of ELITE does not prove every displayed record materially shaped the stop.
Mobile Fortify facial recognition is a separate system and causal input.
A preliminary injunction against warrantless arrest practices does not prove ELITE correction, deletion or termination.
The official congressional inquiry is evidence of oversight and an acquisition route, not a completed technical audit.

source datasets, provenance, address-confidence method and immigration-nexus definition
operation-specific ELITE queries, map outputs, target packages and user identities
field-office intelligence record and supervisor approvals
plate-check, Mobile Fortify and other database query logs
complete timeline joining each system output to officer observation and arrest decision
ELITE audit, access, retention, correction, deletion and incident records
Palantir support, escalation, defect and post-incident change records
ICE compliance reports and observed injunction implementation
person-level compensation, record correction, residual injury and successor-system evidence
decisive_acquisition_contract.falsifier: The complete operation file shows that ELITE and Palantir had no material role in selecting the geographic location or shaping the operation, independent lawful evidence controlled the stop and arrest, pre-action individualized findings were completed, and effective correction and remedy preceded material injury.
decisive_acquisition_contract.stopping_rule: Preserve the geographic-prioritization chain and direct person-level consequence while refusing individual-identification, sole-causation, vendor-decision, correction, deletion or extraction claims until the exact records close them.
